brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.evidence: The shelf is three full bases two storeys high (piece:0..2,0,0 and piece:0..2,0,1). Its top is three flush covers on cover:*,0,1;full;top, making one surface about 453×310 mm. Book rows prop:1 and prop:2 sit on it.
There are two drawers, drawer:0#0,1#cut and drawer:0#1,1#cut, one in each of the half bases piece:0,1,0 and piece:1,1,0.

requirements.requirement: Rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: The configurator checks only fit and collisions. It has no load ratings, and the strength depends on the printed material and settings, which I can't see. No weight rating can be claimed.

finish.summary: I built a shelf unit with two drawers, but I can't rate it for 50 kg. It's three full hex bases in a row, two storeys high, with flat covers on top as the book shelf (about 453 × 310 mm). In front are two half bases, each with a drawer, and covers on them. I closed all open faces with end caps and bolted the joints together. check_build passes with no rule issues, and the collision check came back clear. For display there are two rows of books on the top shelf; there wasn't room for a third set of books in the middle. The configurator only checks how parts fit and whether they collide. It can't tell what weight the build will hold, which depends on the plastic and print settings you choose. So the 50 kg rating is not met: test the unit before you load it heavily. The full build is 75 parts, about 3.6 kg of filament.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
